empty.body: A name is all you need. Contract value, costs and billing can come later.

reports.title: Reports & analytics
reports.description: Organization visibility in the base currency. Every figure is labelled Actual, Committed, Forecast, Commercial, or Estimate. VAT is never profit. Currencies are never mixed.
reports.excludedForeign: {count, plural, =1 {# project excluded (other currency)} other {# projects excluded (other currency)}}
reports.truncatedRollup: {count, plural, =1 {# additional active project omitted from this rollup (cap 50)} other {# additional active projects omitted from this rollup (cap 50)}}

sections.commercialHint: Contract value only — not billing and not payment.
sections.cashHint: Invoiced and Paid are Actual. Outstanding and aging are from Outstanding AR. Forecast in/out uses due dates.
sections.costHint: Actual expenses and labor stay separate from Committed PO and Forecast vendor-bill payable.
sections.profitabilityHint: Estimated profit = current contract − estimated final cost. VAT is excluded from profit.
sections.operationsHint: Counts only — no notification delivery. Shown when you have permission and data.
sections.comparisonHint: Base-currency projects only. Committed is shown beside Actual, never added into it.

disclosures.baseCurrencyOnly: Amounts use organization base currency only.
disclosures.vatNotProfit: VAT is never treated as profit.

inclusions.primaryContractsBaseCurrency: Includes: primary contracts in base currency
inclusions.expensesAndLaborEntered: Includes: entered expenses and costed labor
inclusions.openPurchaseOrderCommitments: Includes: open / partially consumed PO commitments
inclusions.actualPlusEnteredRemaining: Includes: actual plus any entered remaining cost
inclusions.currentContractMinusEstimatedFinal: Includes: current contract − estimated final cost
inclusions.plannedPastTargetDate: Includes: planned milestones past target date
inclusions.draftIssuedPartiallyReceived: Includes: draft, issued, partially received POs
inclusions.noDocumentAttached: Includes: artifacts without an attached document
inclusions.assetsWithProjectAssignment: Includes: assets assigned to a project

exclusions.entriesMissingRate: May understate when rates are missing
exclusions.incompleteCostCoverage: May be incomplete when cost sources are not configured
exclusions.maintenanceCostAsExpense: Excludes: maintenance metadata amounts as Expense

cashFlow.title: Cash view — Actual vs Forecast
cashFlow.actualHint: Payments recorded with a payment date in this month-to-date range. Not a Forecast.
cashFlow.forecastHint: Outstanding billing by due date. Not Paid. Does not invent collection timing.
cashFlow.outgoingDisclosure: Outgoing cash is not forecast here: no open vendor bills with due dates are in scope. Expenses alone do not invent vendor invoices.
cashFlow.outgoingAvailableHint: Forecast from open vendor bills by due date — not Expense actual cost.
cashFlow.undatedNote: Amounts with no due date are listed under “No due date” and are not assigned to a Forecast week.
cashFlow.paymentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No payments in range} =1 {# payment} other {# payments}}
